```text
Usage: libfossil repo open [<dir>] [flags]

Open a checkout in a directory

Arguments:
  [<dir>]    Checkout directory (default: current dir)

Flags:
  -h, --help                     Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING              Path to repository file
  -v, --verbose                  Verbose output

      --cone=CONE,...            Make a sparse checkout: materialize and track
                                 only this path's subtree (repeatable)
      --cone-not=CONE-NOT,...    Exclude this path's subtree from an enclosing
                                 --cone (repeatable)
```
